About Us
Monte Construction PTY LTD is an Australian structural steel construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality steel fabrication and construction solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. With a team of experienced engineers, detailers, and fabricators, Monte Construction specialises in the design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of structural steelwork for a diverse range of projects — from multi-storey commercial buildings and industrial facilities to bridges and civil structures. 

About the role
The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. This role ensures all steelwork is detailed accurately for fabrication and erection. The position requires strict adherence to Australian Standards and project specifications. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between structural design and practical fabrication.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Generate detailed fabrication drawings, erection plans, and assembly drawings.
•	Produce accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting lists, and bolt lists for procurement.
•	Identify and resolve design clashes before fabrication commences.
•	Draft and submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to engineers or architects to resolve design discrepancies.
•	Liaise with the workshop to resolve fabrication queries and optimize detailing for manufacturing efficiency.
•	Work with site supervisors to ensure erection plans are clear and practical.
•	Ensure all detailing complies with the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Update models and drawings promptly to reflect design changes and site variations.
•	Maintain accurate records of drawing issues, revisions, and transmittals.
•	Self-check all drawings for dimensional accuracy and completeness prior to formal review.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel structures), AS/NZS 1554 (Structural steel welding), and AS 5131 (Structural steelwork fabrication and erection).
•	High level of accuracy in drafting and mathematical calculations.
•	Ability to visualize complex 3D structures from 2D architectural and engineering plans.
•	Proven ability to manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical coordination.
•	Proactive approach to identifying design flaws and proposing practical solutions.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

In return we offer you:

•	A collaborative and supportive team environment.

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

(As a Clinical Nurse Educator, you will Lead and inspire nursing teams through effective education and clinical guidance. Mentor and support staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning. The Role

The CNE provides coordination, delivery and evaluation of clinical nurse education (including programs) at the ward-unit level. Such education may include orientation and-or transitioning for new nursing staff, undergraduate and casual nurses as well as meeting the ongoing educational needs of existing nursing staff. Provides clinical supervision at the point of care within everyday clinical practice, in line with the ANMC Decision Making Frameworks for Nurses and Midwives.

Prince of Wales Hospital and Community Health Service is a Level 6 Tertiary Referral Hospital with an inpatient bed base of 370. Each year we care for more than 70,000 patients in our Emergency Department and have around 50,000 admissions to the inpatient units. POWH offers an outpatient service and rural outreach service and provides more than 900,000 occasions of non-admitted patient care each year, including innovative virtual models of care. We have transitioned the majority of inpatient units and wards to the Acute Services Building (ASB) including a state of the art Emergency Department and Intensive Care Unit. At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof.

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.
